Supports the development of campaign key visuals from concept through final adaptation across all required channels, formats, and sizes. Produces advertising materials for OOH and print, ensuring artwork is production-ready and meets supplier specifications. Designs branch and in-clinic collaterals — signage, wayfinding, menus and price boards, window graphics, packaging, and merchandising materials. Maintains and updates brand assets, master templates, and design libraries so the team works from a single, current source. Prepares print-ready files to supplier specifications and reviews returned proofs. Supports Healthspan and other group brand design requirements as needed Collaborates with the Creative Manager on design scheduling and turnaround commitments to ensure timely and efficient production workflows. Ensures all design outputs meet branding guidelines and uphold high creative and technical standards. Stays updated on industry trends such as AI integration, analyses competitor activities, and introduces innovative techniques to continuously elevate design output. Performs related tasks

jobs.title: Product Designer-Builder | StellarTech
jobs.description: Role: Product Designer-Builder Company: StellarTech Location: Remote. StellarTech has offices in Warsaw and Cyprus if you'd like to work from one. The team overlaps 10:00–16:00 CET. Search focus: Poland, Czech Republic, Romania, Serbia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Cyprus, Dubai and the wider Middle East; Western Europe is also possible. We can't consider Russia, Belarus or Ukraine at the moment. Job Type: Full-time, B2B contract Compensation: €4,500–5,500/month gross, paid in USD About StellarTech StellarTech is a self-funded multi-app company that launches consumer mobile products in different domains. It is profitable, moves at startup pace and is aiming for $1B in revenue. You would join Smartimi, the company's biggest and most mature app, as the design partner of its PM, Darya. Around you: a content team that builds templates, a product analyst, engineers and QA. The Head of Product has a UX background himself. The team speaks Russian; the users speak English. What you are expected to do: Take raw problems, ideas and initiatives and turn them into flows, prototypes and shipped UI for a consumer mobile app. Work as a pair with the PM, and own some initiatives fully, from idea to release to reading the numbers. Work directly with engineers and review the build before it ships. Run A/B tests, read the results in Amplitude and plan the next iteration. Talk to users: run interviews in English and launch quick surveys. Build features yourself with vibe-coding or no-code tools when that's faster. The team has a way to test and ship them. Marketing banners and funnels are handled by a separate team, so they are not part of this role. What you need to succeed: 3+ years in product design, with at least 2 (ideally 3) in consumer mobile apps. B2B-only backgrounds won't be a fit. Strong, modern mobile UX and UI craft. The Head of Product looks closely at portfolios, so yours should show it. Ownership: when a problem lands on your desk, you carry it through without waiting

jobs.description: Dein Impact Du gestaltest für eine Zukunft, in der Menschen seltener Apps öffnen und der Agent sie dort erreicht, wo sie gerade sind: im Chat, per Messenger, Mail, Sprache oder Benachrichtigung. Gestaltet wird das Erlebnis über alle Kanäle, nicht über einzelne Screens. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen eine agentische KI erleben, die sie durch ihr Arbeitsleben begleitet und dabei unterstützt, souverän über ihre Karriere zu entscheiden. Dazu gehört, dass sich ein System, das in ihrem Auftrag handelt, nachvollziehbar, vertrauenswürdig und leicht bedienbar anfühlt. Du entscheidest mit, was wir bauen, nicht nur, wie es aussieht. Neue Fähigkeiten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Product von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Konzept. Du verantwortest den Bereich Design & UX und legst das Fundament für ein wachsendes Produkt: Prinzipien, Design System, Informationsarchitektur und eine Arbeitsweise, die mitwächst. So arbeiten wir Wir bauen agentische KI nicht nur als Produkt, wir arbeiten auch selbst damit. In unserem agentengestützten Entwicklungsprozess wird aus Konzepten in kurzer Zeit lauffähiger Code, mit automatisierten Reviews und Tests in jeder Phase. Für dich heißt das: Zwischen deinem Entwurf und dem fertigen Feature liegen Tage, nicht Monate. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entwicklung und KI-Agenten zusammen, testest Ideen am echten Produkt statt am Klickdummy und entwickelst die Art, wie Design und Engineering bei uns zusammenarbeiten, aktiv weiter.
